## 2026-11-18T08:58:00Z | orchestrator -> orchestrator | PROPOSAL

**why structured.** §20 has fields the metrics file did not carry (commits, PRs, reviewer, locks, threads,
next task, blockers, Director questions, the "what this enables" line). Rather than let the generator invent
them, the metrics file now has a `result` block. The generator reads both the numeric sections and that
block; if either is missing, it fails.

**fail closed.** Every required field goes through `text`, `array` or `numeric`; an empty string, an empty
array or a non-finite number exits 1 with the field name and the metrics path. `NOT COMPUTABLE` is only
produced from an explicit `null` in a measured source (CIS, tick p95, bandwidth), never from a missing key.

**acceptance summary from data.** The command line reports the count of logged acceptance commands and how
many exited non-zero, naming each non-zero command — including the three intentionally broken blueprint accs.
It does not pretend they passed.

**FULL mode.** The ten extra §20 lines come from `result.full`; fields that are genuinely unmeasured
(content math, economy, retarget coverage) say so rather than being filled with a guess.

**no verify change.** `verify.mjs` detects stubs by their `console.error('NOT IMPLEMENTED')` banner. Removing
the banner drops `session-result.mjs` from the deferred list while leaving all 17 enabled steps untouched.
